Noida Airport Authority Launches Residential Plot Scheme

The Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority (YEIDA) has announced a scheme offering residential plots near the Noida International Airport in Jewar. The scheme aims to provide opportunities for plot acquisition in the vicinity of the airport. Specific details regarding plot sizes and application conditions have been released. The authority has also specified eligibility criteria, indicating that certain individuals or groups may not be able to apply for these plots.
